# Citum Native Format — Worked Examples

One worked example per reference class, inlined from the test-backed fixtures
under `examples/data-model/`. Each fixture round-trips through
`InputReference` in `crates/citum-refs`' example-verification test, so a stale
example fails CI rather than silently drifting from the schema. See
[DATA_MODEL.md](DATA_MODEL.md) for the concepts these examples illustrate.

## Monograph

Structural class: monograph — a monolithic work published or produced as a complete entity, such as a book or technical report.

```yaml
# Structural class: monograph — a monolithic work published or produced as a
# complete entity, such as a book or technical report.
references:
  - id: kuhn1962
    class: monograph
    type: book
    title: The Structure of Scientific Revolutions
    author:
      - family: Kuhn
        given: Thomas S.
    issued: "1962"
    publisher:
      name: University of Chicago Press
      place: Chicago
    isbn: "9780226458113"
```

## Collection

Structural class: collection — a collection of works published under one cover, such as an edited anthology or conference proceedings.

```yaml
# Structural class: collection — a collection of works published under one
# cover, such as an edited anthology or conference proceedings.
references:
  - id: geertz1973
    class: collection
    type: anthology
    title: The Interpretation of Cultures
    editor:
      - family: Geertz
        given: Clifford
    issued: "1973"
    publisher:
      name: Basic Books
      place: New York
```

## Collection Component

Structural class: collection-component — a component of a larger monographic collection, such as a chapter in an edited volume. `container` embeds the parent `collection` inline via `WorkRelation` rather than referencing it by id.

```yaml
# Structural class: collection-component — a component of a larger monographic
# collection, such as a chapter in an edited volume. `container` embeds the
# parent `collection` inline via `WorkRelation` rather than referencing it by id.
references:
  - id: geertz1973-thick-description
    class: collection-component
    type: chapter
    title: "Thick Description: Toward an Interpretive Theory of Culture"
    author:
      - family: Geertz
        given: Clifford
    issued: "1973"
    pages: "3-30"
    container:
      class: collection
      type: anthology
      title: The Interpretation of Cultures
      editor:
        - family: Geertz
          given: Clifford
      publisher:
        name: Basic Books
        place: New York
```

## Serial

Structural class: serial — a serial publication (journal, magazine, newspaper) treated as a standalone reference, e.g. for citing a journal's editorial policy rather than one of its articles.

```yaml
# Structural class: serial — a serial publication (journal, magazine,
# newspaper) treated as a standalone reference, e.g. for citing a journal's
# editorial policy rather than one of its articles.
references:
  - id: nature-journal
    class: serial
    type: academic-journal
    title: Nature
    issn: "0028-0836"
```

## Serial Component

Structural class: serial-component — a component of a larger serial publication, such as a journal or magazine article. `container` embeds the parent `serial` inline via `WorkRelation` rather than referencing it by id.

```yaml
# Structural class: serial-component — a component of a larger serial
# publication, such as a journal or magazine article. `container` embeds the
# parent `serial` inline via `WorkRelation` rather than referencing it by id.
references:
  - id: watson1953
    class: serial-component
    type: article
    title: "Molecular Structure of Nucleic Acids: A Structure for Deoxyribose Nucleic Acid"
    author:
      - family: Watson
        given: James D.
      - family: Crick
        given: Francis H. C.
    issued: "1953-04-25"
    pages: "737-738"
    container:
      class: serial
      type: academic-journal
      title: Nature
      volume: "171"
      issue: "4356"
```

## Patent

Flat class: patent — a specialized reference class outside the five structural classes, with its own required field (`patent-number`) rather than a `type` discriminator.

```yaml
# Flat class: patent — a specialized reference class outside the five
# structural classes, with its own required field (`patent-number`) rather
# than a `type` discriminator.
references:
  - id: page1998-pagerank
    class: patent
    title: Method for node ranking in a linked database
    author:
      - family: Page
        given: Lawrence
    assignee:
      name: The Board of Trustees of the Leland Stanford Junior University
    patent-number: "US6285999B1"
    jurisdiction: US
    authority: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office
    filing-date: "1998-01-09"
    issued: "2001-09-04"
```

## Dataset

Flat class: dataset — a specialized reference class outside the five structural classes, with no `type` discriminator at all: `required` on this class is just `class` itself.

```yaml
# Flat class: dataset — a specialized reference class outside the five
# structural classes, with no `type` discriminator at all: `required` on this
# class is just `class` itself.
references:
  - id: gapminder2023
    class: dataset
    title: Gapminder World Development Indicators
    author:
      - name: Gapminder Foundation
    issued: "2023"
    version: "2023-08"
    doi: "10.5281/zenodo.8253260"
    repository: Zenodo
```
